description:
The pre-merge canary-impact selector needs measured per-test durations to size shards and to estimate runner-minutes and wall time; selected-file counts alone cannot establish cost, because each shard also pays several minutes of setup and test runtimes vary widely. Today the canary shards write only a pytest text log.

Change: each release-canary.yml shard also writes a JUnit XML report (pytest --junitxml) into its existing uploaded artifact directory, and the run records per-shard setup time (checkout, uv sync) separately from test time.
